answer: A page name matches as a path does: any part, any case, in the name or the path. ervic gives Services, probe gives both probe pages, how fluid and how-fluid give How Fluid Engine works, Home and /home give Home. zzz, contact us and site give no row. 21 typed by real keys, no row pressed.
ours: The same rule: the row's name and path, any part, any case. Ours has its own pages. Read on 13 words.
pressed: Named presses with an on-top check. Typing by real keys in the search and link fields. Unnamed: real clicks on blocks and a drag, the box Edit by Enter since it opens focused. No Save, no upload, no Reset, no tile or row pressed, Copy and Remove Link not pressed.
